content: Internal Revenue Service, Special Investigator Reynolds speaking. How may I assist you today?
Hi, I got a call saying there was some kind of tax issue? I'm not really sure what's going on.
Yes, our system flagged your account for unpaid federal income taxes from the last two years. This is a very serious IRS matter and needs your immediate attention.
Wait, IRS? Taxes? I just started working last year. I thought my taxes were handled.
Unfortunately, our audit department has detected discrepancies in your filings, leading to a significant outstanding balance, including penalties and accrued interest.
But I filled out all the forms at my job, and no one told me I owed anything. How much am I supposed to owe?
According to our records, the total liability is $3,742.16, including legal fees. If this isn't resolved within the next hour, the IRS is authorized to initiate enforcement procedures.
Enforcement? What does that mean? I'm already struggling to pay my student loans.
It means your bank accounts can be frozen, your driver's license revoked, and you could face federal charges for tax evasion. You may also be subject to wage garnishment and property liens.
Oh my God, I, I didn't know! I can't afford any of that. What do I do?

You have one opportunity to resolve this before your case is handed over to the U.S. District Court. I can help you settle the balance, but you must act now. Do you have access to your online banking or payment apps?
I have my phone and a bank account, yes. I really don't want to get in trouble.

Listen carefully: you need to make an immediate federal tax settlement payment. The IRS can only accept this through a verified payment channel today. We recommend using either a wire transfer or purchasing government-approved gift cards.
Gift cards? That seems weird. Are you sure that's what the IRS wants?
This is a temporary measure due to high fraud risk. If you delay or question these instructions, my authority obliges me to escalate your file and activate an arrest warrant.
No, please! I'm just confused. What kind of cards do I need to get?
You will need to go to a reputable retailer and buy either Target, Apple, or Google Play gift cards totaling $3,700. Scratch the code on the back and provide it to me over the phone for verification.
That's a lot of money. I don't think I have enough in my account.
How much do you have available? If full payment is not possible, a partial settlement may delay enforcement for 24 hours, but you must provide proof immediately.
Maybe $1,500 on my debit card. Can I do part of it?

Yes. Purchase $1,500 in gift cards now and call me back with the codes. I'll then update your IRS file to prevent immediate action. Do not disconnect or speak to anyone else about this until payment is confirmed.
Okay. Should I just go to the store right now?
Yes. Remain on the line while you make the purchase. If the call drops, your file will be flagged as non-cooperative, and law enforcement will be alerted.
Alright, I'm heading out the door now. Please, I really don't want to get arrested or lose my license.
As long as you comply, I will ensure your case is marked as resolved. Let me know when you arrive at the store, and I'll guide you through the next steps.
